buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used for equilibration and loading

salt_name.description: Name or identity of the salt used in the buffer

process_run_id.description: Identifier of the automated process run (as configured on the robot/controller)

pump_speed.description: Pump speed during loading / equilibration steps
pump_speed.unit: arbitrary unit or mL/min as defined in SOP

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per condition on the plate

resin_mass_mg.description: Mass of resin used per well

ligand_name.description: Name or identity of the ligand/solute loaded onto the resin

total_volume_ul.description: Total liquid volume per well used for the isotherm experiment

pump_duration_s.description: Duration of pump operation for loading / equilibration

incubation_time_min.description: Incubation time for reaching equilibrium loading

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used in the experiment (order as laid out on plate)

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles performed on the resin

ligand_concentrations.description: List of initial ligand concentrations loaded on the resin (per row)

measurement_wavelength_nm.description: Wavelength used by the plate reader for absorbance measurement

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of the absorbance-to-concentration calibration curve

salt_concentration_unit.description: Unit for salt concentrations (e.g. mM, M)

salt_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the salt solution

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit for ligand concentrations (e.g. µM, mM)

ligand_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the ligand solution

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of the absorbance-to-concentration calibration curve

equilibration_cycle_duration_s.description: Duration of a single equilibration cycle

number_of_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations used on the plate

number_of_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations (rows) used on the plate

analysis_status.description: Status of the loading isotherm analysis as reported by the analysis script

analysis_timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were committed to the database

summary.description: Key numerical summary metrics from analysis

files_processed.description: Number of raw data files successfully processed

num_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of ligand concentrations used (from metadata)

num_salt_concentrations.description: Number of salt concentrations used (from metadata)

replicates.description: Number of replicates per condition (from metadata)

langmuir_fits_per_salt.description: Number of salt conditions for which Langmuir fits were successfully obtained

metadata_used.description: Subset of metadata used directly by the analysis script (copied from analysis JSON)

langmuir_fits.description: Per-salt Langmuir fit parameters and diagnostics from the analysis script

data_files.description: Output data file paths produced by the analysis script plus folder listings

plots.description: Plot file paths produced by the analysis script

raw_analysis_output.description: Full JSON output structure from analyze_experiment (for debugging / provenance)
